task.description: Freeze the observable pre-refactor ESP32-S3 firmware baseline.

dataset.reason: This comparator is embedded firmware, not a dataset evaluation.

evaluation.required_path: fullclean -> build -> size -> flash -> boot/UART/BLE/CAN/motor smoke

build_success.description: ESP-IDF v5.5 full project build exits successfully.

app_partition_overflow_bytes.description: Application image does not exceed the 1 MiB app partition.
app_partition_overflow_bytes.derivation: idf.py size; image 608233 bytes with about 42 percent free.

boot_smoke_success.description: The flashed ESP32-S3 boots and runs for 60 seconds without reset or panic.

ble_nus_smoke_success.description: The target advertises, exposes NUS, accepts commands, notifies responses, and reconnects.
ble_nus_smoke_success.source_ref: two Windows BLE GATT sessions; three consecutive commands and a 3.250-second rediscovery on 2026-08-06

twai_error_counter_final.description: TWAI remains RUNNING with no accumulated bus, TX, RX, arbitration, or missed-frame errors.
twai_error_counter_final.source_ref: pre/post motor and three-cycle impedance status snapshots

dual_motor_smoke_success.description: Both RS01 devices report independently and complete the impedance start/stop smoke.
dual_motor_smoke_success.source_ref: 150 samples per motor plus three 10-second impedance cycles; one joint dense cycle and per-motor cross-cycle long coverage passed 0.5 Hz antiphase fitting

verification.confirmation_method: durable local/Git evidence; dedicated artifact confirmation tool unavailable

summary: ESP-IDF v5.5 build, ESP32-S3 flash/boot, UART, BLE NUS, two RS01 feedback paths, and three impedance start/stop cycles passed.
known_deviations: sdkconfig was regenerated from ESP-IDF 5.3.1 to 5.5.0 without an intended product behavior change.
The physical flash is 16 MB while the frozen prototype image remains configured for 2 MB.
The current feedback snapshot and BLE feedback cannot reliably attribute simultaneous dual-motor feedback.
Physical left/right mapping and mechanical zero are intentionally deferred to the hip-joint object stage.
next_route: Proceed to phase 1 common types and hardware configuration using baseline-esp-can-v0 as the comparator.
